title: Premiere Dent Dental Clinic

hero.description: A clean, trust-focused dental clinic website built to improve visibility, simplify appointment inquiries, and present services clearly.

overview: A modern dental clinic landing page built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Cloudflare Pages with an Email API-powered contact form for seamless client inquiries.
problem: The clinic needed a stronger online presence and an easy, professional way for patients to contact them and learn about services.
solution: I designed and built a responsive landing page with a polished layout, clear service sections, and a working inquiry form to make the clinic easier to reach online.
process: Mapped the clinic's needs and user journey for new patients.
Built a clean responsive landing page with a strong visual hierarchy.
Integrated a contact form flow and deployed the site for public access.
features: Modern dental branding and service layout
challenges: Balancing professionalism and approachability while keeping the experience clear and conversion-focused on mobile devices.
outcome: The clinic now has a modern online presence that is easy to navigate, visually consistent, and geared toward patient conversion.

title: VA Portfolio

hero.description: A personal portfolio website showcasing digital services, skills, and project highlights with a clear contact pathway.

overview: A personal portfolio website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, designed to showcase my skills, projects, and experience as a Virtual Assistant and Web Developer.
problem: I needed a portfolio that clearly presented my work and services while making it easy for potential clients to reach out.
solution: I created a clean personal brand site with structured sections for projects, skills, and contact details, making the digital portfolio easy to navigate.
process: Defined the portfolio structure around service positioning and examples.
Built the responsive UI and content blocks for skills and projects.
Added a contact flow for inquiries and final deployment.
challenges: Creating a portfolio that felt personal yet professional enough to attract service-based opportunities and freelance work.
outcome: The portfolio gives a polished first impression and makes my capabilities easy to understand for potential clients and collaborators.

title: InvestIQ

hero.description: A full-stack investment dashboard focused on portfolio insights, analysis, and user-friendly financial data visualization.

overview: A full-stack investment portfolio analysis platform built with React, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and Recharts. It was developed as part of a four-person Agile team, focusing on backend architecture, data flow, functionality, UX design, and testing.
problem: The project required a scalable way to present investment portfolio information while keeping the interface intuitive for users who needed quick insights.
solution: We built a full-stack platform with a dashboard focused on portfolio data, analytical views, and a smoother experience for interacting with financial information.
process: Worked in an Agile team to define the product requirements and data flow.
Built the frontend and backend structure around portfolio analysis features.
Implemented testing and refinements to improve reliability and usability.
challenges: Coordinating a multi-person build while keeping architecture, UX, and data flow consistent across the project.
outcome: The app resulted in a functional investment analysis product that demonstrates both technical depth and collaborative development work.

title: Beyond The Stars

hero.description: A 2D platformer game blending gameplay mechanics, level design, and custom art assets into a playable experience.

overview: A 2D platformer game developed in Unity using C#. It includes core gameplay mechanics, player movement, game logic, collision handling, and overall functionality, with custom assets created by a collaborating designer.
problem: The goal was to build a playable 2D platformer with polished movement and basic game systems while collaborating on art assets.
solution: I implemented the core mechanics and gameplay loop in Unity, integrating movement, collisions, and design elements to create a complete playable prototype.
process: Defined the gameplay flow and player mechanics.
Implemented movement, collisions, and game logic in Unity.
Integrated custom assets and tuned the game for a smoother experience.
challenges: Creating responsive gameplay and polished interactions while working with custom visual assets and limited production time.
outcome: The project delivered a playable prototype that showcases both technical implementation and creative collaboration.
